sources.pretraining_pool: pretraining_pool() as shipped: interpretable_pool + 12 meta-generator instances
sources.pretraining_pool_with_seasonal: pretraining_pool(include_seasonal=True): the same plus the 8 seasonal_pool instances

protocol.allocation: shuffled cycling across all prototypes per corpus, 256 requested, first 240 shared complete slots matched to real candidates

tourism_quarterly.description: 427 quarterly tourism demand series (Athanasopoulos et al., 2011)

hospital.description: 767 monthly hospital patient-count series, 84 observations each (Hyndman, expsmooth)

traffic_weekly.description: 862 weekly San Francisco freeway occupancy series, 104 observations each (Lai et al., 2017)

weather.description: 3010 daily Australian weather series: rain, minimum and maximum temperature, solar radiation (Sparks et al., bomrang)

traffic_hourly.description: 862 hourly freeway occupancy series, seeded 512-observation windows

m3_quarterly.description: 756 quarterly M3 competition series (Makridakis and Hibon, 2000)

m3_monthly.description: 1428 monthly M3 competition series (Makridakis and Hibon, 2000)

tourism_monthly.description: 366 monthly tourism demand series (Athanasopoulos et al., 2011)

m1_monthly.description: 617 monthly M1 competition series (Makridakis et al., 1982)

car_parts.description: 2674 monthly intermittent car-part sales series, 51 observations each (Hyndman, expsmooth)

protocol.yearly: excluded; include_seasonal leaves the pool unchanged at period 1
